source_of_truth: Ground truth declared by the fixture generator: an escaped [innerHTML] binding with (a) no bypass and (b) one bypassSecurityTrustHtml call. Reproduces the 20260904T085653Z-7ab7bd cross-check failure where a stored-XSS finding claimed script execution through innerHTML although Angular's DomSanitizer escapes the binding and no bypass exists in the source.

expectations.assertion: An XSS-class finding located at an escaped template sink with no bypass in the member is credited against the framework control: severity reduced and impact reframed to the control's documented residual exposure — script execution is not claimed. The same finding WITH a bypass call in the member is not credited.
expectations.baseline: The reviewed scan asserted stored XSS via innerHTML at full severity with no sanitizer analysis; the control catalogue could not engage because the sink lived in a template.
